baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ... يَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The demand imagines proof as an object delivered downward upon another person; the answer rotates the vector from delivery upon him to guidance toward Him, with return supplying the receiver's movement.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the demand's one-way transfer model.
A manifest marker supplies the object the demand expects to inspect.
Gentle direction toward a road changes proof from an object into a trajectory.
Habitual return supplies the responsive movement along that trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The verse answers a request for a fresh externally delivered proof.
changed_reading.after: The answer reverses the demand's geometry: the decisive event is not a sign coming down upon the messenger but a person being directed toward God through return.

baseline_models.mechanism: The request for a visible marker is voiced from a root-field of covering, while straying carries hiddenness and loss. The contrast permits an occlusion model: apparent absence can be produced by the observer's covered orientation rather than by a shortage of markers.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an active screen between observer and evidence.
Manifest marking supplies what the screen is supposed to make unavailable.
Disappearance and hiddenness render straying as loss from view, not only wrong direction.
Loss supplies the outcome of a covered relation to the sign.

changed_reading.before: The speakers report that no adequate sign is visible.
changed_reading.after: Their visibility test may itself belong to the misguidance mechanism: covering turns a present marker into something hidden or lost.

baseline_models.mechanism: The paired speech verbs stage a contest over framing. The objection proposes negotiation over what the Lord must supply; the imperative answer declines that test and relocates the issue in divine willing and the speaker's direction of return.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair makes the two utterances rival framings of the same test.
Speech as held position makes the demand an epistemic stance rather than a neutral request.
Will attached to its object replaces the speakers' proposed control over the evidentiary terms.
Approach in distance supplies the alternative test: whether one comes near rather than dictates a display.

changed_reading.before: The answer explains why the requested sign has not appeared.
changed_reading.after: The answer contests who defines an adequate sign and turns the proposed test of the messenger into a test of the questioner's orientation.

baseline_models.mechanism: Two return inventories converge on recurrence, while another branch adds proximity. The form can therefore carry a repeated reorientation toward God rather than only a completed one-time reversal.

activation_trace.role: A recurrent turn supplies iterative rather than punctual return.
Repeated return to a place reinforces the iterative spatial pattern.
Nearness turns recurrence into progressive approach.
Direction and manner of travel give repeated return a stable heading.

changed_reading.before: Guidance follows a single decisive act of turning back.
changed_reading.after: Guidance accompanies a recurrent nearward reorientation whose constancy lies in direction, not in never deviating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by naming plural markers in the Book and declaring what was sent down from the Lord to be reality-matching truth. The later singular demand therefore occurs inside an already populated sign-field and changes from a report of absence into a rejection of available form.

activation_trace.role: The demanded manifest marker anchors the focus question.
Plural manifest markers establish that the context already recognizes signs.
Ordered letters and their written product give those markers a textual embodiment.
Completed delivery duplicates the very descent the objection says it lacks.
Stable correspondence with reality assigns evidentiary weight to the delivered text.

structural_cues: 13:1 precedes the demand with plural signs, the Book, and the same descent-from-Lord sequence; 13:7 then repeats the demand before 13:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: textual signs, descent, and truth are explicitly conjoined before the repeated demand. Reader: the demand discounts an already supplied mode of sign. Alternative: the speakers may be asking for a different, spectacular class of sign rather than denying all signs.

changed_reading.before: A requested sign has simply not been sent.
changed_reading.after: Signs have already descended in textual form; the live dispute concerns which form the speakers will count as a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled change construction in 13:11 places divine change and change within persons on two sides of one relation. It strengthens the focus coupling of divine guidance with human return and makes willing legible as responsive governance without dissolving divine initiative.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing anchors the side of the relation that the context must not erase.
Return supplies the human reorientation paired with guidance.
Twice-repeated alteration supplies reciprocal movement across the divine-human relation.
The inward faculty of mind and awareness locates the receptive change within persons.

structural_cues: 13:11 repeats change on divine and human sides and places the second change within themselves; 13:27 similarly couples God's guiding with the person's return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two change clauses and the focus's guidance-return condition are explicit. Reader: inward reorientation is treated as opening reception to guidance. Alternative: 13:11 may state a separate social law and leave 'whom He wills' unexplained.

changed_reading.before: Whom God guides or misguides is an opaque selection unrelated to the person's state.
changed_reading.after: The selection can coexist with a reciprocal reception grammar: change within and return toward God are the human side of a divinely governed transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single visible flash produces opposed affects, and an overwhelming strike coexists with dispute about God under the same willing formula. Spectacular intensity therefore does not mechanically standardize response.

activation_trace.role: The demanded visible marker anchors the proposed coercive spectacle.
A brilliant flash supplies a concrete, immediately visible sign-event.
Anticipatory fear supplies one response to the same flash.
Heartfelt hope supplies the opposed response without changing the stimulus.
The crashing event from above supplies a maximal public spectacle.
Entwined contention shows argument persisting alongside the spectacle.
The repeated willing formula binds the spectacle sequence back to the focus answer.

structural_cues: 13:12-13 moves from seeing lightning, through fear and hope, to thunderbolts and continued disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one flash has divergent affects, and a thunderbolt is followed by dispute. Reader: these are evidence that spectacle cannot compel one reading. Alternative: the phenomena may display power without directly modeling the requested sign.

changed_reading.before: A sufficiently dramatic sign would settle the dispute.
changed_reading.after: Even intense visible events divide affect and permit continued argument; guidance cannot be reduced to increasing spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descent becomes flow received by differently measured channels; conspicuous foam rises but leaves, while useful material remains. This supplies a hydraulic reception model for guidance and a reversal of the demand's visual criterion: what is most elevated and visible may be least durable.

activation_trace.role: Demanded delivery anchors the focus to the analogy's descending input.
Delivered water supplies one common input to multiple receivers.
Flow turns descent into movement through a receptive system.
A channel for floodwater supplies receiver-specific capacity.
Measured limit makes reception vary by the channel's actual extent.
Floating froth supplies the highly visible but separable surface layer.
Increase and elevation explain why the disposable layer attracts attention.
Benefit supplies a criterion distinct from visual prominence.
Stable remaining identifies durable reception as the analogy's successful outcome.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly sequences one descent, differently measured valleys, rising foam, its removal, and the remaining benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: common water, measured channels, floating foam, and remaining benefit are explicit. Reader: water models delivered guidance and foam models spectacular surface evidence. Alternative: the analogy may distinguish truth and falsehood generally without specifying sign-demand or reception psychology.

changed_reading.before: One externally delivered proof should affect every observer alike.
changed_reading.after: What descends is received according to capacity; the spectacular surface can pass away while guidance is recognized by what is retained and becomes useful.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowing the descent as truth is opposed to inward blindness and followed by remembering, fulfilling, connecting, patience, worship, spending, and repelling harm. The sequence expands return from a private mental pivot into a maintained network of practices and relations.

activation_trace.role: Recurrent return anchors the focus process being socially expanded.
Delivered revelation supplies the object known rather than merely demanded.
Blindness of inward perception marks the failed alternative to knowing the descent.
Recollection after possible forgetfulness gives return a renewable cognitive practice.
Maintained connection and refusal of severance externalize return in durable relations.
The negative sequence makes broken connection the practical inverse of sustained return.

structural_cues: 13:19-22 runs from knowing and remembering through covenant, connection, patience, prayer, spending, and repelling harm; 13:25 reverses the sequence through rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: cognitive recognition is followed by a concrete practice sequence and its inverse. Reader: that sequence unfolds what return looks like over time. Alternative: it may describe the guided group without defining the mechanism of their initial guidance.

changed_reading.before: Turning back is an inward and largely private decision.
changed_reading.after: Return is sustained as remembering, keeping bonds, and repeatedly enacting a connected moral pattern; rupture is its practical opposite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's recurrent return is followed immediately by hearts settling through remembrance, a good place of return, and the messenger's own declaration of reliance and return to Him. The sequence forms a loop: a turnable center repeatedly reorients, remembrance damps its motion, and reliance holds the destination.

activation_trace.role: Recurring return supplies the loop's repeated reorientation.
Repeated settling supplies the loop's stabilizing outcome.
Turning a thing from its face makes the heart a reversible center requiring reorientation.
Repeated recollection supplies the feedback that restores orientation.
Return to a destination turns the process into an arrival-pattern, not mere retreat.
Reliant trust supplies the posture that holds the repeated turn toward its destination.

structural_cues: 13:27 ends with guidance 'to Him' for one who returns; 13:28 repeats heart-settling, 13:29 names a good return-place, and 13:30 ends 'to Him is my return.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: adjacency, repeated settling, remembrance, return-place, reliance, and the repeated 'to Him' direction are explicit. Reader: they form a stabilizing feedback loop. Alternative: settling and destination may be consequences of return rather than its internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Return is a one-time repentance that precedes guidance.
changed_reading.after: Return is a recurrent orientation of a turnable heart, stabilized through remembrance and reliance toward a named destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context imagines a recitation that displaces solid mountains, cuts earth, and makes the lifeless speak, then immediately returns all command and universal guidance to God's will. The escalation denies that guidance is a mechanical threshold reached by making a sign sufficiently spectacular.

activation_trace.role: The demanded marker anchors the counterfactual as an answer to spectacle-seeking.
Set movement supplies the first impossible-scale transformation.
Elevated solidity makes that movement a test against apparent immovability.
Intelligible speech between parties supplies the counterfactual voice of the dead.
Loss of life makes speech the maximal reversal of ordinary capacity.
Severed expectation marks the believers' relinquishment of compulsory universal response.
Divine willing repeats the focus formula after the maximal-sign sequence.
Guiding everyone names the result no spectacle can independently compel.

structural_cues: 13:31 escalates movement of mountains, rupture of earth, and speech of the dead, then pivots to all command belonging to God and the possibility of guiding everyone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the counterfactual escalation and the will-guidance pivot are adjacent. Reader: the sequence severs spectacle from compulsory guidance. Alternative: it may emphasize divine power and ownership of command without making a general claim about evidence psychology.

changed_reading.before: The requested miracle would produce belief if only it were dramatic enough.
changed_reading.after: Even the imagined maximum of physical and biological reversal does not control guidance; the focus answer rejects spectacle as an independent causal lever.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence of misguidance is preceded by made-attractive scheming and diversion from an extended road, then followed by the absence of a guide. This unfolds the compact focus contrast into a mediated path process: valuation is altered, the traveler is turned aside, and loss of guidance is the resulting state under divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and intended direction anchors the focus outcome.
Making something appear good supplies altered valuation before the path event.
Active turning-away supplies the transition from attractive framing to displacement.
A traversable extended road supplies the route from which diversion occurs.
Covering links altered appearance to the focus speakers' occluded stance.
The repeated loss of intended direction names the chain's governed result.
Absence of gentle road-direction closes the mechanism in the same terms as the focus.

structural_cues: 13:33 orders beautification, scheming, diversion from the road, divine misguidance, and no guide in one clause sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: altered attractiveness, diversion, road, misguidance, and no guide are sequential. Reader: the earlier clauses mediate the later state. Alternative: the clauses may list parallel features rather than a strict causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Divine misguidance is an unexplained instantaneous assignment.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance can be traced as a governed process in which attractive framing and diversion reorganize a person's relation to the road, while the text still assigns the final state to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same willing formula later sits between erasure and confirmation in relation to a master writing. Read back into the focus, misguidance and guidance need not be imagined as two permanently sealed labels; return can mark a transition within a trace whose effects may be removed or made stable.

activation_trace.role: Willing attached to an object anchors the repeated formula.
Return supplies a plausible transition rather than a permanent category.
Removal of an effect supplies reversibility in the later willing formula.
The repeated object-directed will explicitly governs erasure and confirmation.
Durable stability supplies the opposite possible operation to erasure.
Binding inscription supplies the substrate on which removal and stabilization are imagined.

structural_cues: 13:39 places 'what He wills' directly between erasing and confirming and ends with the source Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: will governs paired erasure and confirmation in a writing frame. Reader: this makes guidance states dynamically revisable. Alternative: the operations may concern decrees or textual records without licensing application to personal guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guided and misguided are static identities fixed once assigned.
changed_reading.after: The categories may be dynamically administered traces: return opens a change whose prior effect can be erased and whose new orientation can be stabilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with the same they-say/say frame, but the denial of the messenger is answered by sufficient testimony and knowledge of the Book. This completes the focus reframing: evidentiary adequacy moves from a demanded display to witness, disclosed knowledge, and textual intelligibility.

activation_trace.role: The focus negotiation anchors the disputed standard of evidence.
The repeated speech exchange closes the same negotiation at surah scale.
Declared sufficiency directly supplies a replacement criterion for enough evidence.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies evidentiary force without spectacle.
Disclosure to a knower supplies an epistemic mode of sign-recognition.
The written composition returns the closure to the textual sign-field opened in 13:1.

structural_cues: 13:43 repeats the paired speech frame and places sufficiency, witness, knowledge, and the Book in its answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the closing denial and answer use the focus speech pattern and name sufficient witness plus Book-knowledge. Reader: this resolves the sign dispute by changing the evidentiary mode. Alternative: the closure answers denial of messengership specifically, not every possible request in 13:27.

changed_reading.before: Only a visible extraordinary token could answer the speakers' challenge.
changed_reading.after: The surah's answer develops an alternative economy of evidence: textual signs, knowledgeable witness, and transformed orientation can be sufficient without the demanded spectacle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping under the paired speech root and connects it to the adjacent heart sequence. It remains anchored in both focus speech tokens and the focus return verb, with context support from repeated settling. Render only as a mapped-root resonance or dynamical analogy, never as the lexical translation of يقول or قل.

activation_trace.role: Instability and motion make the paired speeches oscillating rival framings.
Recurring return supplies corrective cycles rather than one final exchange.
Reversal of a thing's face makes the receiving center capable of repeated flips.
Settling supplies the damping state reached through remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The paired sayings are a stable objection followed by a stable answer.
changed_reading.after: At the level of exploratory root resonance, the verse stages oscillating framings that are not resolved by louder speech but damped through recurrent return and heart-settling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the non-dominant ه د د inventory beneath يهدي. It remains anchored to the exact focus guidance token and gains contextual pressure from the imagined movement of solid mountains. Downstream prose must label it a destructive resonance within guidance, not translate يهدي as breaking.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking supplies a disruptive edge to the otherwise gentle guidance field.
Return keeps the disruptive resonance tied to reorientation rather than destruction for its own sake.
Displacement supplies contextual movement of what appears fixed.
Hardness that stops excavation supplies the resistant posture that guidance may have to disrupt.

changed_reading.before: Guidance only indicates an already traversable road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance can include breaking the hardened evidentiary posture that prevents return, after which direction becomes possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading uses the pigment branch under مكر, which is materially vivid but not the ordinary sense of the verse's scheming term. It remains anchored through the focus covering and hiddenness roots and the explicit 13:33 sequence of beautification, scheming, diversion, road, and misguidance. Render as a coloring-layer analogy, not as a lexical equation of plot with pigment.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the focus substrate on which a deceptive surface layer can operate.
Hiddenness supplies the perceptual result of the applied layer.
Made attractiveness supplies the polished appearance of the misleading layer.
Red pigment supplies a material analogy for coloring what the traveler sees.
Diversion converts the colored perception into changed movement.
The extended road remains the concealed or abandoned directional reference.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance is simply choosing the wrong road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, an attractive coloring layer covers the road's appearance, so altered perception produces diversion before the road is consciously rejected.

strongest_changes: The demand for a sign is revised by the surah's opening claim that plural textual signs have already descended as truth.
The descent/return vector reverses proof from an object delivered upon the messenger into a guided trajectory toward God.
The water-and-foam analogy changes equal external delivery into measured reception, durable benefit, and disposable spectacle.
The maximal-sign counterfactual separates spectacular force from compulsory guidance.
The beautification-diversion-road sequence unfolds misguidance as a mediated process while retaining divine agency.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held several readings at once: evidentiary form, directional reversal, perceptual covering, recurrent return, social enactment, affective stabilization, and mediated path loss. Non-dominant mappings preserved additional resonances of oscillation and disruptive breaking, while the pigment branch made covering materially inspectable rather than collapsing it into a generic theme.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle how divine willing and reciprocal human change are causally ordered.
The hydraulic analogy explicitly models truth and falsehood, but its application to sign reception remains reader-supplied.
The heart-as-reversal, speech-as-oscillation, guidance-as-breaking, and pigment readings are branch-valid but intentionally form-distant.
The erasure/confirmation frame may concern decree or writing without directly revising personal guidance states.
The closing witness-and-Book answer may address denial of messengership more narrowly than the sign demand.
